What I am working on

Deciding where AI belongs and how it should be integrated in a course.

Michael LinPrincipal Learning Designer
UQ Business School
Where it started+
0
students were asked how they use AI for learning
The answers were very helpful for the design.
What the answers showed

Most students who rarely check AI output were not using it to find sources at all.

They were asking it to explain things, and accepting the explanation.

So we stopped teaching students to check citations, and started teaching them to check claims.

Built+
0+3
responsible use modules, and three AI coaches
What they do

Modules build judgement inside the discipline. Coaches sit inside one assessment.

The coach challenges reasoning rather than producing it, so the student's own attempt has to come first.
